items.heading: Grapevine Daily Quote October 4
items.text: My life and the lives of those around me do, in fact, form their own parts in a symphony of interaction.
items.attribution: “A New Way of Looking at Life,” Columbus, Ohio, April 1981, Voices of Long-Term Sobriety

items.heading: Cita Diaria con La Viña Octubre 4
items.text: Dejemos que los problemas de hoy se circunscriban al presente.
items.attribution: “Destilación del espíritu”. INDIANÁPOLIS, INDIANA, AGOSTO DE 1982. Del AA Grapevine
